docket_entries.description: AUTO ACCIDENT CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $10,000.00 FILED BY TAN, MAN NA LI, YAN YING AS TO DEFENDANT XIA, YU CHUA ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR DEC-31-2018 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF DEC-31-2018 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF DEC-31-2018 BY CHRISTINE VAN AKEN. PLAINTIFF MAN NA TAN IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF YAN YING LI IS PRESENT. BOTH PLAINTIFFS ARE ASSISTED BY NON CERTIFIED CANTONESE INTERPRETER VIVIAN CHOY. DEFENDANT YU CHUA XIA (XIAO-HUA YU)IS PRESENT AND ASSISTED BY NON CERTIFIED CANTONESE INTERPRETER CHEN YI YU. BOTH NON CERTIFIED CANTONESE INTERPRETERS WERE GIVEN THE INTERPRETER'S OATH BY COURTROOM CLERK R.SAHATJIAN. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED FOR BOTH CASES 18-859430 AND 18-859432 ARE RETAINED IN CASE 18-859430. JUDGE: CHRISTINE VAN AKEN; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN; NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF DEC-31-2018 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF TAN, MAN NA LI, YAN YING RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT XIA, YU CHUA $6,140.00 PRINCIPAL, $90.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $6,230.00, WITNESS HUI JEAN ZENG'S TESTIMONY WAS CREDIBLE AND MORE CORROBORATED THAN DEFENDANT'S TESTIMONY. PLAINTIFF LI SHALL RECOVER $3196.00 PLAINTIFF TAN SHALL RECOVER $2944. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED APR-02-2019 ORDERED DESTROYED
